title: What to say when it is not right
subtitle: Describe what you see, name the slide, say what should be there instead
bullets: It moves in the capture: "The slide webgl must show one still frame in the capture view."
It keeps running after you leave: "Stop the animation and free the renderer when the slide is left."
It is blurry on a large screen: "Draw the canvas at the pixel ratio of the screen."
It is simply wrong: send a screenshot with the wrong part circled. The agent reads the marks
